description: Domain verification profiles that select checks from claims, changed surfaces, and risk. Each profile lists available checks; the selection algorithm chooses which to run based on context. Provider adapters (provider_adapters) are claim-driven lifecycle adapters for the named verification capabilities; they are never globally exposed and never PASS when unavailable.

profile_contract.risk_triggers: Signals that promote an otherwise optional check to required.
profile_contract.cost_class: Relative cost: low, medium, or high.
profile_contract.fidelity: Evidence fidelity: static, process, runtime, native, or visible-runtime.
profile_contract.replayable: Whether a deterministic replay recipe may be emitted.
profile_contract.visible_manual: Manual visibility contract; headless CI is a separate automated mode.
profile_contract.required_dimensions: Evidence dimensions required for the profile claims.
profile_contract.freshness_binding: Identity fields that make evidence stale when changed.
profile_contract.invalidation_conditions: Changes that invalidate an accepted result.
profile_contract.human_residuals: Semantic questions intentionally left for final human review.
